quotes.text: We learned about Copper Cow Coffee at an upscale bed & breakfast in Monterey, California a few years ago while vacationing with family. The lovely gentleman in charge of the nighttime lobby kept bragging they stocked our rooms with “the best coffee you’ll ever enjoy.” I found out he was right!! I don’t like strong coffee and its mild and easy flavor is just perfect for me. It’s just swell to finally find the perfect blend for me…
quotes.name: Carolyn J. M.

quotes.text: Been purchasing from Cooper Cow consistently for probably two years or so. I get the classic and my wife loves the churro. Great product, great company.
quotes.name: Ken M.

quotes.text: Ok so I love this coffee. It’s quite pricey but I think that’s because it’s the real deal. Strange to think the less chems and the less ingredients the higher the cost, yet it is this way more often than not! Ok so, I can’t do coffee, it attacks my guts. Causing many issues for me. I have heard a variety of reasons why this could be. It has not been something I wanted to deep dive to find a good coffee so I haven’t! Until this!! This coffee doesn’t upset my stomach at all.
